import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    mod = int(next(it))

    max_j = n * n + 5
    dp = [[0] * max_j for _ in range(n)]
    dp[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in range(max_j):
            for cnt in range(i + 1):
                if j - cnt >= 0:
                    dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i-1][j-cnt]) % mod
                    if dp[i][j] == 0:
                        dp[i][j] += mod

    sums = [[0] * max_j for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        s = 0
        for j in range(max_j):
            s = (s + dp[i][j]) % mod
            if s == 0:
                s += mod
            sums[i][j] = s

    max_n = 500
    fact = [1] * (max_n + 1)
    for i in range(2, max_n + 1):
        fact[i] = (fact[i-1] * i) % mod

    ncr = [[0] * (max_n + 1) for _ in range(max_n + 1)]
    ncr[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, max_n + 1):
        ncr[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, max_n + 1):
            ncr[i][j] = (ncr[i-1][j] + ncr[i-1][j-1]) % mod
            if ncr[i][j] == 0:
                ncr[i][j] += mod

    res = 0
    for i in range(n-2, -1, -1):
        cnt = n - i
        pre = n - cnt  # = i
        com = (ncr[n][pre] * fact[pre]) % mod
        if com == 0:
            com += mod
        sum_val = 0
        for dif in range(1, cnt):
            for inv in range(dif, max_j):
                if dp[cnt-1][inv] == 0:
                    break
                if inv - dif - 1 < 0:
                    continue
                x = dp[cnt-2][inv]
                y = sums[cnt-2][inv-dif-1]
                x = (x * y) % mod
                if x == 0:
                    x += mod
                sum_val = (sum_val + x * (cnt - dif)) % mod
        res = (res + sum_val * com) % mod
        if res == 0:
            res += mod
    print(res % mod)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
